name: Memucan
bio: Memucan, one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had the king's ear, advised Ahasuerus after Queen Vashti refused his summons that her defiance would spread contempt for husbands among wives throughout the empire. He proposed an irrevocable decree deposing Vashti and giving her royal position to another; the king and his princes followed his advice (Esther 1:14-21).
